summary: Connected lightweight electric vehicles spanning personal and commercial mobility.
editor_note: Rather than extending a conventional e-bike catalog, the company is building named TM-B and TM-Q vehicle systems with a shared connected software direction. The $150M Series D supports shipping and commercialization, but autonomy remains forward looking and the corrected canonical company domain is ridealso.com.

product_evidence.claim: The corrected official site exposes the TM-B and TM-Q electric vehicles and a connected mobility platform.
The company page establishes the distinct mobility entity, product roadmap and autonomy direction at the corrected domain.

market_context.primary_user: Teams or individuals evaluating and operating connected lightweight electric-mobility system.
market_context.differentiation: ALSO bets on a lightweight connected vehicle class rather than a conventional e-bike catalog.
market_context.why_now: ALSO reported the current financing on 2026-08-19.

risks.claim: The products and company identity are now specific, although later autonomy claims remain forward looking.
risks.basis: VentureDex assessment based on the cited official product and financing evidence.

breakout_exception.reason: The Series D is included selectively because the company exposes named shipping vehicle systems and an integrated hardware-software roadmap, not merely a mature-company financing event. Commercial scale and autonomy claims remain explicitly bounded.
